newsitem.title: LATVIA: Olainfarm leads slow Latvian pre-midsummer trade.
newsitem.headline: Olainfarm leads slow Latvian pre-midsummer trade.

text.p: Prices showed few major changes on the Latvian bourse by the close on Friday, dulled by the prospect of the long midsummer holiday weekend.
Drugs maker Olainfarm registered the biggest turnover amid total turnover that was a higher at 51,000 lats against 40,000 lats.
The bourse index rose by 0.44 points to 380.42 while the Rietumu index advanced to 153.1, up by 0.49 pct.
"Activity was rather low but far better than one could expect on a pre-midsummer session," one dealer told Reuters.
Although Olainfarm, on the bourse for two weeks, was active it rose only by four santimes to 2.55 lats.
"Olainfarm has stabilised somewhat close to 2.50 lats, although fluctuation in a range to 2.10 lats is possible," said Andreta Petersone, a dealer with Hansabank-Latvija.
Kaija fish cannery maintained its slow upward movement, adding one santime to 2.15 lats on turnover of 6,815 lats.
"It seems that the price is advancing on good half-year result expectations," Petersone said.
Elsewhere, leading bank Unibanka also edged up, adding three santimes to 3.33 lats and saw 9,990 lats of shares change hands.
Riga Shipyard lost one santime to 1.33 lats and traded 3,000 lats whilt the Staburadze confectionery and Riga Transport fleet stayed put.
Staburadze registered trade worth 4,519 lats at 2.69 lats and the RTF had volume of 2,638 lats at 1.20 lats.
On a generally slow secondary list, Valmiera Glassfibre and Mangali Shipyard were in relatively high demand.
Valmiera slipped to 1.39 from 1.43 lats on 4,726 lats turnover on 4,762 lats turnover and Mangali had volume of 2,398 lats. It lost four santimes to 1.10 lats.
